integrity: Finite exact-rational tests supplement a complete algebraic proof. Bibliographic comparisons are bounded; a comparable earlier formulation is possible. No independent scientific validation or audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact real-arithmetic, two independent unit rows, uniform iid projections, consistent system, squared mean-row residual. No general higher-dimensional, nonuniform, relaxed, inconsistent or floating-point claim. A general order-1/t bound was previously known; exact geometry extremizers are the contribution.
title: Sharp finite-horizon residual envelopes for two-line randomized Kaczmarz
